name: Inada Shin'ya
source:
Birthplace: Chiba Prefecture
Lives with his parents, older brother, and older sister.
He has a natural sense of rhythm and works as a club DJ even though he's so young.
Despite his parents being teachers he hates putting effort into studying and brushes it off as just his way of doing things.
A bit of a selfish and overconfident guy. He's not very cooperative, but he has the charisma of a leader.
